decision_conditions: The premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class C of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification).
The number of children cared for, at any one time, shall not exceed 5
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<div>Prior to commencement of development, details of shelters, racks, dimensions and location of cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp; </div><div>Cycles parking spaces should be secure and sheltered. LB Harrow do not support the provision of vertical cycle storage systems as this excludes less able people from being able to securely store their cycle.&nbsp;</div>
The number of bedspaces available shall not exceed 6

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:
</p><ol><li>identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point </li><li>is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures </li><li>is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread </li><li>provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users </li><li>develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in
6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.
The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</li></ol>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Site Location Plan labelled Dwg: 01 V2;</li><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Site Block Plan labelled Dwg: 02 V2;</li><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Existing Floor Plans labelled Dwg: 04 V2;</li><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Proposed Floor Plans labelled Dwg: 05 V2;</li><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Existing and Proposed Elevations labelled Dwg: 06 V2;</li><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Planning, Design and Access Statement (Drafted by Planning By Design Ltd)&nbsp;</li></ul>
description: Change of use from dwelling (Use class C3) to children's care home (Use class C2)
